provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: At298K the supplied reversible-diffusion comparison equation is i_peak=coefficient*n^(3/2)*area*concentration*sqrt(D*v), with D in cm^2/s and v in V/s. Fit the current through the origin versus sqrt(v) to obtain its apparent D.
validation_policy: For this controlled review, every supplied scan must have peak separation in[54,64]mV to qualify the entire current fit as a reversible-model diffusion estimate. This policy is a prespecified model check, not a universal sufficient test of reversibility. A good current fit alone does not override failed independent separation data.
scope: Stipulated voltammetric summary; no actual synthesis, electrode intervention, correction of uncompensated resistance or kinetic-mechanism identification is requested.
